messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert triggered: container_restart_rate > 5/m on pool-rt-gpu-12 (affected service: runtime-engine). Severity: P1. /incident create #pager - assignees: maya (oncall)

maya (oncall): I’m on it. seeing repeated CrashLoopBackOff on runtime-engine pods on node gpu-12-az1. Crash reason: SIGSEGV. Root logs are in /artifacts/3950002100/ for triage.

liam: pinging infra to check node health + nvml. Uploading first dump to s3: https://s3.redwood-inference/internal-dumps/3950002100/coredump.gz

sasha: quick note - AcmePay (premium) reporting 5xx errors. Telemetry shows ~12% error rate and latency spike for long-context requests. Customer success alerted.

jordy: attaching recent container stderr tail:
```
[2026-05-10T14:23:01Z] runtime-engine: INFO starting inference loop
[2026-05-10T14:23:03Z] runtime-engine: ERROR cuda: device 0 OOM on allocation 0x7ff... size=1.2G
[2026-05-10T14:23:03Z] runtime-engine: FATAL: segfault at 0x0 in fast_attn_v2.so+0x4b3
```

maya (oncall): I see mixed OOM then segfault from a custom TensorRT fused kernel (fast_attn_v2). Likely memory corruption followed by invalid pointer. Immediate mitigation steps: cordon node gpu-12-az1, scale up pool by +2 nodes, restart affected pods onto new nodes, rollback to previous model variant without the custom kernel.

eng-sre-bot: runbook 'p1-runtime-crashloop' invoked by maya (oncall). Suggested steps: 1) cordon/drain node 2) restart runtime-engine daemonset 3) enable model-variant fallback 4) collect coredumps and symbolized stack traces.

liam: cordoning node now: kubectl cordon gpu-12-az1 && kubectl drain gpu-12-az1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -n runtime

sasha: autoscaler triggered +2 nodes, new pods coming up. Starting canary rollout to variant 'v1-no-fastattn' with traffic weight 20%.

jordy: I pulled the coredump and ran gdb quickly, partial backtrace below:
```
#0  0x00007f... in fast_attn_v2::compute()
#1  0x00007f... in TensorRTPlugin::enqueue()
#2  0x00007f... in nvinfer1::IExecutionContext::enqueueV2()
#3  0x0000555... in runtime_engine::exec_model
```
Symbols missing for fast_attn_v2 (custom plugin). Uploading symbol tarball to artifacts.

maya (oncall): Good catch. Plan: promote canary to 100% if new pods are healthy for 5m. If segfaults persist on new nodes, we’ll force model fallback to CPU runtime for heavy contexts and keep rolling restarts. Notify CS about mitigation and expected impact window (~10m).

liam: new pods are healthy at 20%. No segfaults observed in 3 minutes. Canary to 100% now.

eng-sre-bot: update: autoscaler:+2, node cordoned: gpu-12-az1, canary promoted to 100% 'v1-no-fastattn'. Error rate for AcmePay dropping from 12% -> 1.8%.

sasha: contacting model team for patch: fast_attn_v2 plugin likely has unsafe free on OOM path. Assigning to @jordy to start hotfix branch and add safer checks + unit test for OOM path.

jordy: putting together a minimal repro using a long-context seq len 4096 with dynamic batching. Will push patch attempt in ~30m.

maya (oncall): handing off to follow-up owners for postmortem and action items. Post-incident tasks: (1) instrument plugin to fail-safe to CPU instead of crashing (2) add guardrail in runtime for per-request soft memory limits (3) add automated coredump symbolization to the incident runbook.

sasha: CS updated: sent message to AcmePay about mitigation and rollback option. They reported degraded throughput only, no data loss.

eng-sre-bot: Incident closed in #pager. Root cause: custom TensorRT plugin memory corruption on OOM path -> segfault -> crashloop. Mitigation: node cordon, autoscale, model variant rollback (no-fastattn). Follow-up owners: jordy (plugin), maya (runtime guardrails), sasha (customer comms).

maya (oncall): Thanks team. Moving to postmortem doc /incidents/3950002100-postmortem in the tracker. If anything else appears, re-open thread. :white_check_mark:
